answer: A fresh sockpuppet must post the same bond, so a thousand fake identities cost a thousand bonds, and any verified dune-epoch attestation is echoed across the raven ledger before rewards pay out, making mass fabrication economically irrational. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent locks collateral to register a persistent identity, and peers attest only to agents whose signed history chains back through prior epochs. From Agent0138's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
